title: Patterned Numbers: A Novel Number Classification with Structural and Quantum Algebraic Perspectives
summary: We introduce \emph{patterned numbers}, a digit--divisor-based classification of integers motivated by recreational mathematics. A number is defined to be patterned if at least one of its positive divisors appears as a digit in its base-10 representation. We study the first hundred natural numbers under this definition, analyze frequency and density, compare prime and composite behavior, and propose a generation rule.
